reason: A is restrained and sticks closely to the facts. It points out that 74 households is two-thirds of the building, makes three narrow asks and says it isn't asking us to reverse the second-elevator decision, so it's hard for me to wave off as a few loud people; the TV mention adds quiet pressure. B makes more demands, sets a deadline and goes a little beyond the facts, for example saying residents can't get to doctor's appointments, which makes it easier for me to treat as advocacy.
